description: This file defines Express routes related to doctor functionalities, including login, appointment management, profile updates, and dashboard access. It sets up route handlers and middleware for a backend API.

methods.name: doctorRouter.post('/login')
methods.description: Handles POST requests to log in a doctor.

methods.name: doctorRouter.post('/cancel-appointment')
methods.description: Handles POST requests to cancel an appointment, protected by authDoctor middleware.

methods.name: doctorRouter.get('/appointments')
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve doctor's appointments, protected by authDoctor middleware.

methods.name: doctorRouter.get('/list')
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list doctors.

methods.name: doctorRouter.post('/change-availability')
methods.description: Handles POST requests to change doctor's availability, protected by authDoctor middleware.

methods.name: doctorRouter.post('/complete-appointment')
methods.description: Handles POST requests to mark an appointment as complete, protected by authDoctor middleware.

methods.name: doctorRouter.get('/dashboard')
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch doctor dashboard data, protected by authDoctor middleware.

methods.name: doctorRouter.get('/profile')
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve doctor profile, protected by authDoctor middleware.

methods.name: doctorRouter.post('/update-profile')
methods.description: Handles POST requests to update doctor profile, protected by authDoctor middleware.
